purpose: Establish direct ChatGPT subscription image generation and original-image editing feasibility before designing the NOE integration.
status: direct-service-probe-passed; NOE integration and managed authentication pending

request.generate_prompt: A single solid mint green square centered on a plain white background. Flat colors, crisp straight edges, no text or other objects.
request.edit_prompt: Change only the mint green square to solid orange. Keep the square's shape, position and size, and the plain white background.
request.edit_input: The exact generated PNG encoded by the host as images[0].image_url, an inline data URL.
request.transport: Direct HTTPS from a standalone Python probe, no Codex subprocess or API-key fallback.

visual_review.method: Opened both saved PNG files with the local image viewer
visual_review.original: A mint green square centered on a white background
visual_review.edited: An orange square centered on a white background, with visually similar position and size
visual_review.conclusion: The requested color change is visible. Exact preservation of all other pixels is not claimed.

observed_dimension_difference: Both returned PNGs are 1254x1254 despite a requested 1024x1024 size. Integration must return dimensions read from actual image data rather than echo requested dimensions.

checks: actual original bytes in edit request

limitations: Success applies to the selected account/environment and the tested model/options, not a general third-party service support guarantee.
The probe does not establish NOE-native login, managed refresh, real quota-error/cancellation behavior, or the actual JavaScript/agent vision workflow.
One PNG edit input was tested; JPEG/WebP, multiple inputs, transparency and masks were not live-tested.
Usage, image request IDs and provider response model were not captured by this minimal probe.
Visual inspection confirms the requested color change, not exact preservation of all other pixels.

references.finding: NOE uses Sign in with ChatGPT plan-sharing tokens for api.openai.com/v1; its image registry currently rejects chatgpt-oauth.
The public plan-sharing Responses route lists image generation among unsupported tools. This does not by itself establish how every standalone image endpoint handles those credentials.
The documented resource audience for those tokens is https://api.openai.com/v1. NOE tokens should not be assumed interchangeable with Codex backend credentials.
Codex defaults ChatGPT-authenticated provider requests to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex and appends images/generations or images/edits for image operations.
Codex bearer authentication adds Authorization and ChatGPT-Account-ID; image requests also add a turn ID and optional originator/turn metadata.

Codex edits send actual image content as JSON images containing image_url data URLs. The inspected tool uses gpt-image-2 and limits edit references to five in the client; that is not proof of a service-wide limit. No mask field appears in the inspected request schema.
Built-in image generation counts against Codex usage limits. Availability and limits remain account/workspace dependent.

sensitive_data: This record contains no tokens, account identifiers, authorization headers, image base64, or raw credential/OAuth records.
